reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative: The main goal of this project is to support mental health services in Gaza Strip to improve the well-being of the Palestinians living in Gaza. This support is a joint effort with Sweden and SDC, considering the level of hardship and stress in the Gaza Strip. The grant is intended to maintain and strengthen the mental health services provided to socially and emotionally stressed Palestinians, especially women and children affected by the conflict. The recipient advocates for women and children to access adequate mental health services through the grant. The recipient will prioritize mentally ill and disabled Palestinians by providing mental health assessment, counselling and treatment. The recipient conducts extensive assessments and research to study trends, needs, underlying causes and the effectiveness of assessment and treatment protocols. It is relevant to SDG 5 as the grant contributes to preventing discrimination and household violence and ending harmful practices and supports women to be more active in their societies and ensure access to essential mental health services.
